verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS like Moosend, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys or scoping them. The closest items are team-member 'controlled access' and SSO/SAML, which cover human user access rather than least-privilege API credentials for an agent, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
